PH.thesis_one_line: World-class maker of aircraft and factory motion parts, growing fast, but priced for more growth than it can deliver after a debt-funded $11.8 billion buying spree.
key_adverse_facts: Filtration Group ($9.25B cash, closed 13 Aug 2026, 8-K 0001193125-26-349148) and pending CIRCOR Aerospace ($2.55B) lift pro forma net debt/EBITDA from about 1.3x to about 2.7x-3.0x (my arithmetic); covenant ratio debt/(debt+equity) was 0.36 versus a 0.65 maximum and is about 0.53-0.57 pro forma.
FY27 guidance (adjusted EPS $34.25-$35.25) excludes both deals, so reported numbers will change; market multiple 28.1x FY27 guide midpoint.
FY26 adjusted EPS excludes an $84M tariff refund (non-recurring), GAAP EPS $28.48 versus adjusted $32.31; amortisation $4.56 per share.
Reverse DCF needs about 8% a year pro forma FCF growth for 10 years versus company target of 4-6% organic growth.
data_conflicts: Triage NTM P/E 26.8x versus 28.1x on the FY27 guide midpoint (guide excludes acquisitions).
Filtration Group sales/EBITDA are from a secondary source (19.6x EBITDA, about $2B revenue); the 10-K does not give them.
PH.confidence_in_thesis: medium: quality and guidance record verified from filings; valuation conclusion sensitive to WACC and to acquired-business cash flow (my estimate); Form 4 and 8-K 5.02 items not opened
kill_criteria: Consolidated debt to debt-plus-shareholders'-equity ratio (10-K/10-Q covenant definition, Parker-Hannifin consolidated) above 0.60 at any quarter-end (0.36 at 30 Jun 2026; covenant maximum 0.65), or a downgrade of S&P below BBB.
Organic sales growth below 3% for two consecutive quarters (4Q FY26 +8.0%; FY27 guide 5.5% to 8.5%).
FY27 adjusted EPS guidance (ex-acquisitions) cut below the $34.25 low end, or adjusted segment operating margin below 26.5% for two consecutive quarters (FY26 27.3%; FY27 guide 27.5% to 27.9%).
Rolling 12-month total order growth below 0% in either segment (Parker +12% and Aerospace +18% in 4Q FY26).
Filtration Group or CIRCOR integration: any goodwill impairment above $500m, or CIRCOR not closed by 30 Jun 2027 (expected second half of calendar 2026 per the 10-K).

valuation_view_vs_v1.reconciliation: No V1 row exists for PH. Reverse DCF implies about 8.0% a year pro forma unlevered FCF growth for 10 years (WACC 8%, terminal 3%) versus my base of about 5.6%; even the bull case (about 7.8%) values the equity 5% below the market cap.

PH.scenario_basis: Start price 978.33 and FY26 adjusted EPS 32.31 (FY27 guide ex-deals 34.25-35.25); Sep-2029 NTM adjusted EPS bear 38 at 17x, base 45 at 23x, bull 50 at 26x; dividend $8.00 growing about 3% (about $25 over 3 years).

TFC.thesis_one_line: Big Southeast US bank earning about 15% on tangible equity, priced near book value and handing back about 13% of its value yearly, despite slowing interest income.
key_adverse_facts: Full-year 2026 net interest income growth guide cut at consecutive calls: 3-4%, then 2-3% (Apr 2026), then 1-1.5% (Jul 2026); revenue growth guide cut to 3.5-4% (call transcripts, secondary source).
2Q26 ROTCE 15.4% was helped by other income of $208M versus $102M in 1Q26; NIM-TE fell to 2.98% (from 3.02%).
CEO transition: Mike Lyons became CEO 1 Sep 2026; overdraft-fee class settlement up to $240M approved 26 May 2026 (10-Q).
Nonperforming loans rose to $1,692M (0.51% of loans HFI) from $1,577M at Dec 2025.
data_conflicts: Triage ROE 9% (b1 GAAP roe 8.6%) versus company ROTCE 15.4%: different measures, preferred and $18.3B intangibles depress GAAP ROE.
Numeric guidance exists only in slide images and call transcripts; EDGAR deck text has no figures, so guidance quotes come from secondary transcripts.
TFC.confidence_in_thesis: medium: balance sheet, capital and credit verified in the 10-Q; guidance figures and peer multiples rely on secondary transcripts or were not pulled; Form 4 not checked
kill_criteria: CET1 ratio (Truist Financial Corporation consolidated, 10-Q/10-K capital ratio table) below 10.0% at any quarter-end before the end of 2027 (10.9% at 30 Jun 2026).
ROTCE (company non-GAAP, earnings release) below 13.0% for two consecutive quarters (15.4% in 2Q26, 13.8% in 1Q26).
Full-year 2026 net interest income growth guidance cut below 1.0%, or revenue growth guidance cut below 3.0% (now 1% to 1.5% and 3.5%-4%).
Net charge-off ratio above 0.75% in any quarter, or nonperforming loans above 0.75% of loans HFI (0.50% and 0.51% in 2Q26).
NIM-TE below 2.85% (2.98% in 2Q26) or average deposits down more than 2% year on year (up 1.1% in 2Q26).

valuation_view_vs_v1.reconciliation: No V1 row exists for TFC. Reverse DCF on distributable earnings (COE 10%, terminal 3%) implies about +0.4% a year for 10 years versus my base of +3% from a $4.5B start (ROTCE about 14%, below management's 15% goal).

TFC.scenario_basis: Start price 47.66, FY26E EPS about 4.87, TBVPS 33.40; Sep-2029 NTM EPS bear 4.30 at 8.5x, base 5.80 at 9.5x, bull 6.60 at 11x; dividend about $2.08 a year rising (about $6.0-6.8 over 3 years).

IQV.thesis_one_line: World's largest clinical-trial outsourcer and health-data seller with strong bookings, but leveraged and already re-priced after a 57% run from its recent buyback price.
key_adverse_facts: 2Q26 GAAP EPS $1.53 versus $1.54 a year ago while adjusted EPS rose 12%; SBC up 58% to $95M and restructuring doubled to $63M.

Net leverage 3.59x on company definition (net debt $14,090M; about 3.9x after deducting SBC from EBITDA, my arithmetic); $2.0B 6.375% senior notes due 2034 issued 23 Sep 2026 to refinance 5.0% notes (8-K 0001193125-26-399616).
Revenue guide raise in 2Q26 partly M&A (+50 bps) and offset by FX (-80 bps); organic raise about +100 bps.
H1 2026 buybacks averaged about $173 per share (5.5M shares for $950M) versus $270.37 close.
data_conflicts: Triage net debt/EBITDA 4.7x versus company 3.59x (net debt $14,090M over TTM adjusted EBITDA); could not reproduce 4.7x.
b1 market cap $45.1B versus $44.5B on 164.6M period-end shares.
IQV.confidence_in_thesis: medium: guidance record and balance sheet verified from releases and 10-Q; valuation asymmetry is modest and sensitive to cost of equity; peers and Form 4 not pulled
kill_criteria: Net leverage (company definition, consolidated net debt over trailing-twelve-month adjusted EBITDA) above 3.9x at any quarter-end (3.59x at 30 Jun 2026).
R&D Solutions net new bookings book-to-bill below 1.0x for two consecutive quarters (1.22x in 2Q26; 1.18x in 4Q25).
FY26 adjusted diluted EPS guidance cut below $12.80, or organic revenue growth below 3% for two consecutive quarters (R&DS organic 7% in 2Q26).
Stock-based compensation above 2.5% of revenue in any quarter (2.2% in 2Q26, 1.5% in 2Q25), or GAAP diluted EPS below the prior-year quarter for three consecutive quarters (2Q26 $1.53 vs $1.54).
Trailing-twelve-month free cash flow below 85% of adjusted net income (about 103% now on my arithmetic).

valuation_view_vs_v1.reconciliation: No V1 row exists for IQV. Reverse DCF on SBC-adjusted FCF ($1.91B, COE 8.5%, terminal 3%) implies about 5.8% a year versus my base of about 6.5%; base value +8%, bear -20%, bull +23%.

IQV.scenario_basis: Start price 270.37 and FY26 adjusted EPS guide midpoint 12.90; Sep-2029 NTM adjusted EPS bear 14.6 at 15x, base 17.5 at 19x, bull 19.5 at 22x; no dividend (buybacks embedded in EPS).
